question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_constructor_points
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
)
SELECT bd.year, c.name as constructor_name, bd.best_driver_points, cp.constructor_total_points, ROUND(bd.best_driver_points + cp.constructor_total_points, 1) as combined
FROM best_driver bd
JOIN constructor_points cp ON bd.year = cp.year AND bd.constructor_id = cp.constructor_id
JOIN constructors c ON bd.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined DESC
LIMIT 3
